title: Phenotypic and Genotypic Characterisation of a Large, Multicentre Italian Cohort of 46, XY DSD Patients
official: Phenotypic and Genotypic Characterisation of a Large, Multicentre Italian Cohort of 46, XY DSD Patients
summary: Observational exploratory study of a cohort of pediatric and adolescent patients diagnosed with DSD karyotype 46,XY, a rare congenital clinical condition characterized by a disharmonic development between chromosomal sex, gonadal sex and/or phenotypic sex.
